resources.string: Sends one short text for you when someone you know messages while you are away. It is off until you turn it on, and it only ever answers people you have texted before or saved as contacts.
InboxIQ is not your default SMS app right now, so nothing can be sent automatically. Make it the default from the inbox to use this.
One automatic text per person every:
At most this many a day in total:
These can be lowered but not raised. It never replies to businesses, short codes, groups, spam, blocked numbers, picture messages, old texts, or texts that look automatic.
Your carrier may charge for these texts, as for any text you send.
Counts of first-run steps on this phone. Step names and times only: no message text, numbers or names. Nothing is sent anywhere, and release builds keep no such log.

Until it is, Android keeps delivering texts to another app, so nothing new arrives here and nothing sent from here goes out.
Messages still arrive and are sorted. You just will not be notified.
Future texts from this number go to the same place. Your choice stays on this phone and the model is not retrained.
The conversation moves to Junk, where you can restore it. Nothing is sent anywhere; reports stay on this phone.
Include the area code. Add +1 and the country code for numbers abroad.
On top of your phone\'s own font size setting.
Applies to text messages. Picture messages always send immediately.
Save your conversations to a file you choose, or restore from one. Nothing is uploaded. Photos are not included; only text, labels, pins, archive and mute settings, and blocked numbers.
Restored messages are added to InboxIQ only. They are not written to Android\'s own message storage.
